concerns.text: The spec's maximal-overlap edge case (mean pairwise cosine ≥ 0.95) is implemented in T005's agent logic but no task generates or runs against a maximal-overlap library — FR-002 defines only LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH and T002/T007 generate only those. The edge-case behavior is therefore never exercised or verified by any task. Add a task (or extend T002/T007) to generate and run a maximal-overlap condition with the T005 spot-checks.

plan.md's project structure lists tests/integration/test_full_run.py, but no task creates an integration test; tasks only create unit (T006) and contract tests (T001/T003/T004/T008/T010). The plan element has no covering task.

concerns.text: plan.md and the constitution require SHA-256 checksums (and the artifact_hashes map) recorded in state/projects/PROJ-975-...yaml, but tasks.md explicitly forbids writing to state/ and stores checksums only in data/raw/checksums.json. No task satisfies the plan/constitution's state-YAML recording element; either a task must cover it or the plan must be amended.

The spec promises a sensitivity analysis 'sweeping these values over a range of task counts', but T009 sweeps pruning intervals {5,10,15} and library-size granularity only — no task varies task counts. Either add a task-count sweep task or note the deviation.
